headline: Descope: 5 prices, 3 limits changed (added “Yes. You move to the Pro tier if your app has…”)
added: Yes. You move to the Pro tier if your app has either more than 7500 users or more than 50 tenants (or more than 5 SAML tenants). Here are a couple of examples:
If your app has 10 tenants and 8000 MAUs, you will move to the Pro tier because your app has over 7500 MAUs.
If your app has 60 tenants and 500 MAUs, you will move to the Pro tier because your app has over 50 tenants.
If I have more than 7500 MAUs, will I be charged from user 1 or user 7501?

If you exceed the MAU limit on the Free Forever tier, you will be charged for each monthly active user. For example, if your app has 8000 MAUs, you will be charged $800 per month (8000 MAUs x $0.10 per MAU per month).

If you exceed the tenant limit on the Free Forever tier, you will be charged for each tenant. For example, if your app has 60 tenants, you will be charged $1200 per month (60 tenants x $20 per tenant per month).

Since your app can have users, tenants, or a combination of the two, pricing is calculated in an additive manner. The basic monthly pricing calculation is (# of users x $.10) + (# of tenants x $20). Let’s take a couple of examples to illustrate:
If you have an app with 10,000 users and 0 tenants, your monthly price will be $1000 i.e. (10,000 x $0.10) + (0 x $20).
If you have an app with 1000 users and 60 tenants, your monthly price will be $1300 i.e. (1000 x $0.10) + (60 x $20).
What happens if I exceed the number of SMS deliveries per month on the Free Forever tier?
If you exceed 100 SMS deliveries per month while on the Free Forever tier, sign-up and sign-in via SMS will return an error.

You must move to the Pro tier if your app hits any of the limits–more than 7500 MAUs, 10 tenants, or 3 SSO connections.

If I have more than 7500 MAUs, will I be charged from user 1 or user 7501?

If you exceed the MAU limit on the Free Forever tier, you will be charged for each monthly active user. For example, if your app has 8000 MAUs, you will be charged $400 per month (8000 MAUs x $0.05 per MAU per month).

If you exceed the tenant limit on the Free Forever tier, you will be charged for each tenant. For example, if your app has 60 active tenants, you will be charged $300 per month (60 tenants x $5 per active tenant per month).

What happens if I exceed 7500 MAUs or 50 tenants while on the Free Forever tier?

We know that user login is critical as it’s the entry gate to any application. If you exceed the MAU or tenants limit while on the Free Forever tier, you will receive a warning email informing you of the same with a grace period to upgrade to the Pro tier.
